# system.voltageRange

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.16</span></div>

Return the Radio voltage range.

```lua
local min = system.voltageRange()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

min (number) and max (number)

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 2 times across 2 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    function utils.getTxBatteryVoltageRange()
      if system and system.voltageRange then
        local vmin, vmax = system.voltageRange()
        if vmin and vmax and vmin < vmax then return vmin, vmax end
      end
      return 7.2, 8.4
    end
    ```
